description: Use to change the display name, or the default alert channels (email, text) for new alerts, optionally applied to everything already watched. Phones are verified on the site, not here. Only the fields given change. Confirm first.

apply_to_all.description: Also set these channels on every alert already watched.
apply_to_all.title: Apply To All

email.description: Email alerts on new alerts by default.
email.title: Email

text.description: Text alerts on new alerts by default; needs a verified phone.
text.title: Text

name: update_account

applied.description: Handler's per-type apply-to-all result, when returned

channels.description: {email: boolean, text: boolean} stored default channels

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

text_not_enabled.description: Text asked but no verified phone

title: Update the account
